'''Elam Dowtry''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident and a friend of [[Mat Cauthon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elam Dowtry|Elam}}

==Appearance==
He has a long nose and a cowlick. He wears a farmer's wool coat and a sword with its rawhide handle freshly wrapped, though the leather scabbard is flaking and peeling.{{ref/book|4|43}}

== Activities ==
He helps carry [[Perrin Aybara]] inside the [[Winespring Inn]].{{ref/book|4|43}} He helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}

In the fall of {{ne|999}} he ran away from the Two Rivers with [[Dav Ayellin]] and [[Ewin Finngar]] to explore the world.{{ref/book|6|p}}{{ref||Elam}}
